versions.changelog:
- Added .gitignore file to manage untracked files in the repository.
- Added LICENSE file to clarify project licensing.
- No changes to functionality or documentation content.

Context Bridge ensures context persists across sessions, models, and time. Prevents "starting from zero" on every /new or model switch. Provides registries for skills/crons/agents, discovery system, handoff memory, and SOPs to prevent duplication.

I personally HATE explaining what I am doing with the previous model after a change.  So this takes care of that.
